Name: Silkworm Mulberry
Author: omena007
Description:
Here's finally my silkworm mod! It adds Mulberry tree which attracts silkworms which can be hosted in the Silk Rack. After two day cocooning period you can collect the raw silk and put it into the loom to make silk cloth. This mod was greatly inspired by the Chinese game Harvest Town.

* Easy Version *
The tree and the rack come to Pierre's shop 2th year. Worms habit the tree on summer time. 1 worm needed for the rack. 1 cocoon needed for a single cloth.

* Default Version *
The tree is available randomly at Travelling Merchant's wares. The rack can be bought on the third day of the night market at the Magic Boat. Worms habit the tree on summer time. 6 worms needed for the rack. 3 cocoons needed for a single cloth.

Big thanks to the people at SDV discord for helping me out!
